description: Repairs r-fmt-2b/dr-reinsert-same-key-longer-value: no public read between steps (only the whole-file hash existed for the middle steps). Delete then reinsert of one key with a longer value: Dr row 8 is deleted, then ID 8 is inserted again with A 80 and a 60-character Vt. Asks whether the longer row can reuse the freed space; the rows and index statistics are read back after each step. Dr: 20 small rows (ID Long key, A Long, Vt Text(60) 'original text of row <ID>'), ID 1..20. Images: 'before' (the fixture copy as given), then one kept image of the closed file after each step; every step opens the database read/write, makes its mutation and closes it, with the DBEngine still alive.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-fmt-sort probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
